name: IRCON International Ltd.
reason: Government-controlled railway/infrastructure EPC contractor dependent on state order flow, with EBIT margin falling from 10.7% (FY2017) to 5.5% (FY2025, 9th percentile) and EPS down from INR 9.88 (FY2023) to 6.33; a low-moat bidding business with no specialness.

name: Jindal Steel Ltd.
reason: Integrated steelmaker whose earnings are set by steel and coal prices (EPS INR -22.62 in FY2016 to 82.08 in FY2021 and back to 37.08 in FY2025), 10y avg ROIC 4.6% and promoter-group (Jindal) structure.

name: Jindal SAW Ltd.
reason: Commodity steel-pipe and pellet maker with project-driven, volatile EPS (INR 5.08 FY2020, 30.75 FY2023, 14.97 FY2025), 10y avg ROIC 6.9% and Jindal promoter-group links; no durable moat.

name: L&T Finance Ltd.
reason: Indian NBFC (rural/microfinance, housing, two-wheeler loans) whose EPS halved from INR 10.33 (FY2018) to 3.85 (FY2020) on credit losses and only regained the high in FY2025 (11.96), with 10y avg ROE 9.3%, net debt/EBITDA 7.4x and 3.0%/yr share dilution; earnings set by the credit cycle.

name: NHPC Ltd.
reason: State-controlled hydro generator on regulated tariffs with EPS CAGR of 2.5% (INR 2.53 FY2015 to 3.24 FY2025), net debt/EBITDA 11.3x and negative FCF from heavy project capex; regulated-return, government-policy earnings with no record of 7% growth.

name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd.
reason: Phosphate fertilizer producer whose earnings are set by imported raw-material prices and Indian government nutrient-subsidy policy (EPS INR 3.90 FY2022, 1.23 FY2023, 9.59 FY2025); commodity economics with no moat (FactSet EBIT margin series distorted).

name: The Federal Bank Ltd. (India)
reason: Well-run mid-size private bank with EPS INR 4.76 (FY2016) to 9.06 (FY2021) through the low-rate years and 16.56 in FY2025, but 10y avg ROE of only 11.7%, 3.7%/yr share dilution and flat EPS over FY2023-25 (15.87 to 16.56) fall short of the best-in-class through-cycle bank standard.
